description_en: Adds scan results from IDC probes to the whitelist or ignores them
description_zh: 对IDC探针扫描出的结果进行加白或忽略
name: IgnoreIdcProbeScanResult

parameters.description_en:
The IDs of scan results. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

> Call the [DescribeIdcProbeScanResultList](~~DescribeIdcProbeScanResultList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
parameters.description_zh:
扫描结果ID，多个用英文逗号分割。

> 调用[DescribeIdcProbeScanResultList](~~DescribeIdcProbeScanResultList~~)接口获取该参数。

- **2**: ignore.
